model: single passive cavity mode + one monitored vacuum port + two hidden thermal input channels

analytic_statements.fixed_response: t_mm(omega)=1-kappa_m/[A-i omega], with A=(kappa_m+gamma_h)/2+i Delta, independent of theta
analytic_statements.fixed_baseline_noise: n_out,0=kappa_m gamma_h |chi|^2 n0, independent of theta because N_h,0=n0 I
analytic_statements.no_internal_gauge: one internal mode and fixed real monitored coupling remove nontrivial internal realization rotations
analytic_statements.no_signal_tangent_gauge: the declared bath tangent diag(r1,r2) is nondegenerate, so generic continuous bath rotations do not preserve the parameterized input state

interpretation: W3 crosses the W2 collapse: the complete monitored baseline response and baseline output noise are identical, yet the output-field QFI for the same declared parameter changes because the parameter also has an environmental covariance tangent whose projection through the fixed hidden coupling orientation is designable.
claim_boundary: The existence of base-identical but tangent-different Gaussian QFI is not itself a novelty claim; Gaussian information geometry already distinguishes base covariance from covariance tangent.
The repository target must therefore be the physical realizability/synthesis set of admissible covariance/information tangents under fixed response/noise/resource constraints.
This W3 uses bath-occupation modulation as the signal; a stronger follow-up should test dissipative-rate or Hamiltonian signals tied directly to GKSL generator derivatives.
